purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the Annex Eight continuity-ward fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary ward care, the split patient index, the breach alert, competing custody claims, corridor choices, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the corridor establishing frame, patient-registrar routine, folded morning state, the one-sentence amber alert, Sato's entrance and divided-authority demand, the custody decision, corridor pressure, the final threshold, and each ending family. The alert and Sato's entrance remain separate so the pre-arrival room is established first.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt stands alone for a general image model, names visible geometry and body features directly, and includes only visible characters or drawable groups. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: bleak institutional science-fiction noir illustrated as a tactile storybook frame, restrained ink-wash shadows, cold blue clinic light, bruised amber alert light, precise industrial materials, expressive but unsentimental faces, legible silhouettes, humane small details, cinematic composition suitable for interactive fiction.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every image prompt from the global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups visible in that frame, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Keep continuity notes outside prompt text and use the embedded scene_set camera map as geometry authority.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture reuses one corridor from several angles and moves a capsule, cradle, rail, and bodies through branch-dependent positions. The embedded draft map fixes zones, routes, cameras, sightlines, and object states for B-level replay planning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, lower this map into a hand-built plan view or simple 3D blockout with the west public lift, east vault door, south thermal-service door, six alcoves, benches, registrar island, center rail, wall panes, floor guide, and cooling trunk.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of Tycho Continuity Annex Eight on Luna, a long rectangular pressurized clinic corridor about eighteen meters from west to east. A recessed public lift with brushed metal doors occupies the west end; an armored blue-lit embodiment-vault pressure door fills the east end. Six shallow calibration alcoves with articulated diagnostic arches line the south wall. Padded patient benches and mobility supports line the north wall. A waist-high registrar island and removable center rail divide the waiting area from a clear service lane. A sealed south thermal-service door opens toward adjacent cooling works. Pale ceramic panels, brushed steel, exposed coolant pipes, floor guide tracks, cold blue task lights, and small warm soup flasks make the place clinically expensive and humanly inhabited. Augmented patients and caregivers wait on the benches in layered work clothes, visible prostheses, implant access patches, canes, and compact tool pouches.

visible_characters.default_stance: patients and caregivers seated along the north benches or waiting beside mobility supports

visual_continuity_notes: The local coordinate frame is west public lift, east vault, north benches, south calibration alcoves and thermal-service door, with the registrar island near the center-west and one straight service lane between island and vault.
The annex is one clinic corridor adjoining Cryonix service infrastructure, not a habitat-scale complex.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium view at the Annex Eight registrar island under cold blue clinic lights. Nera Seln, a compact middle-aged human woman with warm brown skin, close-cropped black hair, tired dark eyes, and a left forearm made of ivory ceramic shells over brushed metal joints, sits behind the desk in a charcoal registrar vest; her prosthetic index fingertip has a small recessed blue contact. Dr. Ilya Marr, a tall older human man with olive skin, silver hair at the temples, small paired silver implants above both ears, a long gray Finch clinic coat, and careful narrow hands, calibrates an older patient's mechanical jaw at the rail. A clear palm-sized capsule with a blue consent light rests on the desk beside paper repair slips, a padded ward pouch, a clipped soup flask, and a wall pane showing an ordinary queue. Patients pass cups and a borrowed wrist bearing along the north benches; six diagnostic alcoves remain visible across the service lane.

standing at the center rail while calibrating a seated patient's jaw actuator
sharing cups and a compatible spare along the north benches

visual_continuity_notes: Nera's left forearm and delayed index contact remain the same prosthesis in every frame.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Pivotal wide frame inside Tycho Continuity Annex Eight at the instant every diagnostic arch changes from cold blue to bruised amber. Augmented patients look up from cups and spare parts; Nera Seln rises behind the desk, her ivory ceramic left forearm catching the alert light; Dr. Ilya Marr turns from a calibration alcove. scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium-wide view toward the south thermal-service door of Tycho Continuity Annex Eight under amber alert light. The door stands partly open onto exposed coolant pipes and a colder industrial passage. Sato Veen, a lean human courier with freckled pale skin, shaved copper hair, a stained slate-blue pressure jacket, orange seal tape, heavy boots, and black work gloves, pushes a low rugged service cradle through the doorway. The cradle has four thick wheels in the floor guide, folding padded body supports, a battery-coolant block, bundled cables, and an orange record-carrier slot. Nera Seln stands at the center registrar island with ivory ceramic left forearm near the clear capsule; Dr. Ilya Marr reads a white Finch emergency addendum on the wall pane; patients and caregivers wait along the north benches. The blue east vault door is visible at the far end, establishing three separate claims on one service lane.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character and group visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for characters visible in a scene.

characters.nera_seln: Nera Seln: compact middle-aged baseline human woman with warm brown skin, close-cropped black hair, tired dark eyes, charcoal registrar vest over a soft gray shirt, practical dark trousers, and a left forearm prosthesis made of ivory ceramic shells over brushed metal joints. Her prosthetic index fingertip has a recessed blue clinical contact. Her posture is economical; stress appears as checking the delayed finger against edges and keeping her body between the desk and queue.
characters.ilya_marr: Dr. Ilya Marr: tall older baseline human man with olive skin, narrow careful hands, silver hair at the temples, paired small silver implants above both ears, long gray Finch clinic coat over dark scrubs, flat clinic shoes, and a thin silver seal tool at the wrist. Professional posture softens when he calibrates a patient and straightens when company authority speaks.
characters.sato_veen: Sato Veen: lean adult baseline human courier with freckled pale skin, shaved copper hair, stained slate-blue pressure jacket with orange seal tape, heavy black work gloves, magnetic-soled boots, and a compact tool roll. Sato moves behind a low rugged four-wheeled service cradle with folding padded supports, battery-coolant block, bundled cross-vendor cables, and an orange record-carrier slot.

groups.continuity_ward_queue: Annex Eight continuity ward queue: eight to twelve adult and older patients, caregivers, and off-shift technicians with varied skin tones and visibly varied augmentation: ceramic limb shells, exposed brushed-metal joints, implant access patches, one mechanical jaw, one cane user, compact mobility supports, layered gray work clothes, soft clinic wraps, tool pouches, soup cups, and a padded custody pouch. Body language changes from practiced hand-to-hand coordination to guarded gaps according to ward_trust.
groups.zhestokost_aligned_recovery_unit: Zhestokost-aligned continuity recovery unit: four baseline humans in hard gray pressure suits with red command chevrons, sealed helmets, compact breaching tools, restraint webbing, and heavy magnetic boots; visible as a disciplined unit through a grainy junction camera feed, advancing among exposed coolant pipes.

review_notes: Narrative, lore, visual-continuity, and spatial-cohesion self-review verdicts are recorded in the training sidecar; all four accepted after revisions.
The embedded scene_set map is the draft geometry authority for this multi-angle corridor fixture.
All base prompts use affirmative visible descriptions and repeat enough room, body, material, light, interface, and object detail to stand alone.
Character refs are attached only to scenes where the named character or group is visible; the recovery unit appears only through the south-junction camera feed.
Ending-family base frames remain neutral where success and cost states disagree; branch and ending modifiers own the changed body, object, seal, trace, and door positions.
